jurisdiction: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
key_requirements: Consent (guardian consent for children), ministry permit for sensitive data, breach notification, cross-border transfer rules
retention_period: Controller/processor keep processing documents for retention period set by Executive Regulation (MD 34/2024); breach fine OMR 1,000-5,000 (article unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
penalties_range: Up to OMR 500k fine (admin fines up to OMR 2k)
exemptions: Art. 3: national security/public interest; State bodies' competences; legal/court obligation; vital interests; crime detection; personal/family use; research
notes: Royal Decree 6/2022; replaced e-Transactions Law ch. 7; Executive Regulation in force 5 Feb 2024
